summary: Stranded party in the Yankee Hill area (vehicle stuck in a snow drift and partially off trail) located safe and healthy after a ~27-hr backcountry stay
responding_agency: Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery (referred by Gilpin County Sheriff's Office)
notes: Incident date = Memorial Day Monday when the party became stranded (report says "yesterday" of the 2017-05-31 report for the response, stranded "one day prior"). Party found slight cell coverage and called 911; 4x4 R&R assembled and deployed in <4 hrs and located them. Victim count unstated - victims=1 per the 4x4 stranding convention. Notes: response allowed local SAR teams to stay available; comms via ham radio/APRS.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Gilpin County, Colorado, United States)
